name: Apple Upside Down Cake
author: delightsmeaty
instructions: Prepare the Apples: Peel, core, and slice apples into thin wedges.
Make the Caramel Base: Melt butter, brown sugar, and cinnamon in a saucepan; pour into a greased cake pan.
Arrange the Apples: Layer apple slices over the caramel mixture.
Prepare the Cake Batter: Mix dry ingredients in one bowl; cream sugar and eggs in another, then combine.
Combine and Bake: Pour batter over apples and bake at 350°F (175°C) for 40 minutes.
Cool and Serve: Let cool for 10 minutes, then invert onto a serving plate.
